title: The role of RHIM in necroptosis.
authors: Riebeling, Theresa; Kunzendorf, Ulrich; Krautwald, Stefan
one_liner_zh: 该文综述RHIM结构域在坏死性凋亡信号传导中的作用，属于纯蛋白-蛋白互作与细胞死亡机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The RIP homotypic interaction motif (RHIM) is a conserved protein domain that is approximately 18-22 amino acids in length. In humans, four proteins carrying RHIM domains have been identified: receptor-interacting serine/threonine protein kinase (RIPK) 1, RIPK3, Z-DNA-binding protein 1 (ZBP1), and TIR domain-containing adapter-inducing IFN-beta (TRIF), which are all major players in necroptosis, a distinct form of regulated cell death. Necroptosis is mostly presumed to be a fail-safe form of cell death, occurring in cells in which apoptosis is compromised. Upon activation, RIPK1, ZBP1, and TRIF each hetero-oligomerize with RIPK3 and induce the assembly of an amyloid-like structure of RIPK3 homo-oligomers. These act as docking stations for the recruitment of the pseudokinase mixed-lineage kinase domain like (MLKL), the pore-forming executioner of necroptosis. As RHIM domain interactions are a vital component of the signaling cascade and can also be involved in apoptosis and pyroptosis activation, it is unsurprising that viral and bacterial pathogens have developed means of disrupting RHIM-mediated signaling to ensure survival. Moreover, as these mechanisms play an essential part of regulated cell death signaling, they have received much attention in recent years. Herein, we present the latest insights into the supramolecular structure of interacting RHIM proteins and their distinct signaling cascades in inflammation and infection. Their uncovering will ultimately contribute to the development of new therapeutic strategies in the regulation of lytic cell death.
abstract_zh: RIP同型相互作用基序（RHIM）是一种保守的蛋白质结构域，长度约为18-22个氨基酸。在人类中，已鉴定出四种携带RHIM结构域的蛋白质：受体相互作用丝氨酸/苏氨酸蛋白激酶（RIPK）1、RIPK3、Z-DNA结合蛋白1（ZBP1）和含TIR结构域的适配器诱导干扰素-β（TRIF），它们都是坏死性凋亡（一种独特的调节性细胞死亡形式）中的关键参与者。坏死性凋亡通常被认为是一种备用细胞死亡形式，发生在凋亡受损的细胞中。激活后，RIPK1、ZBP1和TRIF各自与RIPK3异源寡聚化，并诱导RIPK3同源寡聚体的淀粉样结构组装。这些结构作为停靠站，招募假激酶混合谱系激酶结构域样蛋白（MLKL），后者是坏死性凋亡的成孔执行者。由于RHIM结构域相互作用是信号级联反应的关键组成部分，并且也可能参与凋亡和焦亡的激活，因此病毒和细菌病原体已发展出破坏RHIM介导信号传导以确保其生存的手段，这并不令人意外。此外，由于这些机制在调节性细胞死亡信号传导中发挥重要作用，近年来受到了广泛关注。在此，我们介绍了相互作用的RHIM蛋白的超分子结构及其在炎症和感染中的不同信号级联反应的最新见解。这些发现最终将有助于开发调节裂解性细胞死亡的新治疗策略。
